NOTE: Do NOT manually edit this file. This file is automatically updated when semantic release (release.yml) runs. Manually editing this file can break your releases and break third party tools that use this file.

patches.name: Force TV mode (UiModeManager check)
patches.description: Universal: makes any app that detects TVs via UiModeManager treat the device as an Android TV. Experimental heuristic.

patches.name: Force TV mode (leanback check)
patches.description: Universal: makes any app that detects TVs via the leanback system features treat the device as an Android TV, including apps that run the check once in an initializer. Experimental heuristic.

patches.name: Force TV mode for Zangetsu
patches.description: Makes Zangetsu treat the device as an Android TV, so the regular phone build shows its TV interface on any device.

patches.name: Rename app (add (TV) suffix)
patches.description: Appends " (TV)" to the app name, e.g. "Zangetsu" becomes "Zangetsu (TV)". Useful to tell a TV-patched copy apart from the original. Experimental: only works when the app takes its launcher name from its manifest label resources - many apps do not, and then nothing changes.

patches.name: Rename app (add TV suffix)
patches.description: Appends " TV" to the app name, e.g. "Zangetsu" becomes "Zangetsu TV". Useful to tell a TV-patched copy apart from the original. Experimental: only works when the app takes its launcher name from its manifest label resources - many apps do not, and then nothing changes.
